ext_min_size_hint: Fayilolin da shafin ya ce sun fi wannan ƙanƙanta suna zama a cikin burauzar. 0: babu.
ext_excluded: Shafukan da aka bar wa burauzar
ext_excluded_hint: Saukewansu suna zama a cikin burauzar. Ɗaya a kowane layi; kowanne ya haɗa da ƙananan yankunansa.
ext_pair_here_hint: Inda aka saka Ottie, wannan burauzar tana shiga da kanta, kuma Ottie yana farawa idan saukewa ta zo.
ext_no_host: Ba a saita Ottie don wannan burauzar a wannan kwamfutar ba: saka manhajar kwamfuta, ko gudanar da umarnin ottie extension install. Ko shiga da mahaɗi.
